discovery_notes: Follow-up to packet 259 (b089); reuses its keys. 30 standard WebSearches, snippets only, blocked domains on every query. Resolved: 5 unnamed D23 2022 FiGPiNs (Boba Fett #502, Boo #807, Ariel, Tigger, Witch Marge #1035) plus Mickey #976/Minnie #977; parks wave 4 full list (#1024-1183); Disney100 wave 3 and Halloween numbers; Chip/Dale WDW50 are separate FiGPiNs (hold released); Ember & Wade is one pin-on-pin (hold released); Stitch jumbo maker Uncas; Snow White 85th and Boba #502 leads dated 2022. New: parks FiGPiN wave 2 and Doctor Strange/Scarlet Witch (2022), Funko Pop!-with-pin 2022 (5) and Funko holiday Pop! Pins 2023 (4), Toynk SDCC 2022 Wreck-It Ralph, FiGPiN SDCC 2023 and NYCC 2023, Monogram Robin Hood 50th, Toynk Indiana Jones, Uncas Cinderella & Jasmine, DPB Vivisteria. Still open: Her Universe Lead character, Innovate (Shuri) retailer-only, Alice/Ariel and Halloween mystery makers, Hallmark none, NYCC 2022 none; Retro/Chibi/Amazon Halloween holds kept.
